housing.summary: Numbeo listed €803.56 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Mannheim city centre, updated 17 July 2026: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Mannheim?displayCurrency=EUR The statutory rental-deposit ceiling is three months of net rent, not a claimed market norm: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/bgb/__551.html Current Mannheim rental listings are available on ImmoScout24: https://www.immobilienscout24.de/Suche/de/baden-wuerttemberg/mannheim/wohnung-mieten?enteredFrom=result_list

banking.summary: Sparkasse Rhein Neckar Nord says a current-account applicant supplies personal information and completes identity verification with a valid identity card or passport: https://www.sparkasse-rhein-neckar-nord.de/de/home/privatkunden/girokonto.html Its account-opening terms also require the account holder tax identification number: https://www.sparkasse-rhein-neckar-nord.de/de/home/privatkunden/girokonto/girokonto-classic-free.html

schools.summary: The official city profile for Liselotte-Gymnasium documents a German-English bilingual profile and the International Abitur Baden-Württemberg: https://www.mannheim.de/de/bildung-staerken/weiterfuehrende-schulen/allgemeinbildende-gymnasien/liselotte The city school directory is Schulatlas Mannheim: https://web2.mannheim.de/schulatlas/

legal_admin.summary: Anyone moving into a Mannheim dwelling must register within two weeks with Mannheim Bürgerservice; registration is available at Bürgerservice locations or digitally, and the city lists the required identity document, registration form and landlord confirmation: https://www.mannheim.de/de/service-bieten/buergerdienste/buergerservice/dienstleistungen/meldeangelegenheiten/an-und-ummeldung-eines-wohnsitzes
legal_admin.registration_step: Register the Mannheim residence within two weeks at a Bürgerservice location or through the digital Bürgerportal.

tax_finance.summary: After first registration in Germany, the registration authority transmits the data and the Federal Central Tax Office assigns the IdNr; if it has not arrived after three months, the newcomer may send the BZSt a copy of the identity document and registration confirmation: https://www.bzst.de/DE/Privatpersonen/SteuerlicheIdentifikationsnummer/FAQ/faq_node.html

transport.summary: VRN sells the 2026 Deutschland-Ticket for €63 per month, valid on local buses, trams and regional trains: https://www.vrn.de/tickets/ticketuebersicht/deutschlandticket/index.html Mannheim states that EU licences can be exchanged without a test, while non-EU licences are valid for six months and exchange requirements depend on whether the issuing state appears in FeV Annex 11: https://www.mannheim.de/de/service-bieten/buergerdienste/buergerservice/dienstleistungen/fuehrerscheine/umschreibung-auslaendische-fahrerlaubnis-und-dienstfahrerlaubnis For statutory healthcare, choose an eligible Krankenkasse and notify the employer of the chosen fund: https://www.bundesgesundheitsministerium.de/service/begriffe-von-a-z/k/krankenkasse/
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU licences can be exchanged without a test; non-EU licences are valid for six months, then must be exchanged, with testing determined by FeV Annex 11 status.
transport.healthcare_registration: Choose an eligible statutory Krankenkasse and notify the employer of the chosen fund.
